body: INDEPENDENT P1R HANDOFF AUDIT — CORE RECEIPTS PASS; TWO SELF-CONTAINMENT GAPS. Read-only verification of /private/tmp/storymodel4s-amr-runtime.EkToyR confirms runtime-handoff.json 6dd741f6..., requirements.freeze.txt 8557f7a3..., exact installed 61-package freeze, Python binary 1110a74e..., qualification script a7fd8c12..., checkpoint archive 515968261 bytes with MD5 f8eb8894... and SHA-256 ecaa2d9b..., all four extracted checkpoint hashes, all four tokenizer hashes, both qualification file hashes, and both receipt digests recomputed from canonical JSON. Each run contains 50 unique indices and sentence hashes, 50 checked-success, 0 other statuses, 624 triples, range 3..38. The canonical retained outcomes list is identical across runs and hashes to b426839a9f043a3be8285ab84c4834f81d4ed8133a5fdfb2c214bc12d974efa1. Gap 1: runtime-handoff.json instead records outcomesSha256 aa65f874..., but qualify_runtime.py never computes that field and no retained file or declared preimage reproduces aa65f874. The handoff therefore cannot independently rederive that claimed identity. Gap 2: the manifest names exact amrlib and Unidecode wheel hashes, but neither wheel file is present anywhere under the handed-off root, so the implementation owner cannot reverify every nested asset as instructed. Installed dist-info is present and the amrlib license hash does verify, but that is not the wheel artifact. Remedy before repository manifests derive authority: retain the two wheel artifacts or a separately immutable local path plus hashes, and define/recompute outcomesSha256 from an explicit retained canonical preimage; otherwise publish b426839a... as the canonical digest of the retained outcomes array. This does not dispute the measured 50 of 50 execution; it blocks only the stronger self-contained identity claim.
